record.name: B_gate
record.description: Keep the guess zero until contact, then change it only while depth stalls.

record.name: B_pullback
record.description: Pull the running guess 1% toward zero each step.

record.name: B_memory
record.description: Give actor and critic a 20-reading mean and change summary.

record.name: B_labels
record.description: Train toward approximate camera-error labels from own successful practice.

record.name: B_fast
record.description: Double the aim nudge limit after contact.

record.name: B_constant
record.description: Try one constant random offset in each fill-up episode.

record.name: B_heat_normal
record.description: Start at the most successful offset from an own-practice heat map.

record.name: B_aim_one_sided
record.description: Run plain aim with one-sided camera bias.
